reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a loan of up to EUR 67.5 million to the iInvesticiji ir verslo garantijos" ("INVEGA or the "Borrower", formerly VIPA), an agency of the Ministry of Finance of Lithuania, to finance demand side energy efficiency investments in residential apartment buildings (the "Project"). The project will help conserve energy, reduce carbon emissions and encourage the use of energy performance practices to generate energy efficiency gains at residential apartment buildings. The project supports an innovative approach to accelerate the pace of renovation of existing buildings through a combination of long term debt financing, incentives, technical assistance and support for low income households.
